name: Government data centre under Parliament Building
developer: Government of Antigua and Barbuda / Ministry of Information and Communications Technologies
notes: Existing government data centre housed under the Parliament building in St. John's/Saint John; sources discuss it as the facility to be replaced by a new national data centre.

name: New national Tier III/Tier IV government data centre
developer: Government of Antigua and Barbuda / Ministry of Information and Communications Technologies
notes: 2024 budget lists development of a new national data center with tier III standards by repurposing/retrofitting a bunker-type building; 2024-2025 Antigua Observer reporting says government planned a new EN 50600/Tier 4 facility for 2025, with location kept confidential for national security. Division assigned to Saint John because the existing Parliament data centre and central government complex are in St. John's, but the new site's exact parish is not disclosed.

name: Antigua Computer Technology (ACT) ISP & Data Centre / Co-location
notes: ACT advertises dedicated data centre cabinets, cages and private suites; local directory lists ACT as ISP & Data Centre with data centre/co-location at Suite 101 TeleDome Building, Old Parham Road, St. John's.
